lines.text: Now read your table as a scientist would.

Ask three classmates to show you their tables.
Find one food that appears in all four diaries, and one food
that appears in only one. Comparing is how we tell what is
You will almost certainly find both. Some foods —
dal, milk, oil, salt, sugar — turn up in nearly every diary in the class.
Others turn up in one diary only, because one family cooks that dish
So even inside a single classroom, food is not one thing. It varies.
